in_marathi.name: Vashu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of blessings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vashu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vashu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vas', which means 'to dwell'. This name is believed to bring blessings and good fortune. It is also associated with the Sun and the Sky, symbolizing strength and power.
